value.body: An agri-input sales officer looks after sales of seeds, fertilisers or crop-protection products in a district or territory. Agri-input companies hire them in large numbers. The day involves visiting dealers, meeting farmers, organising product demonstrations and tracking targets and collections.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Sc Agriculture, sometimes with an MBA (Agri-business) later

items.label: Work setting
items.value: Field-based, with daily travel across a territory

items.label: UG students in agriculture
items.note: All agriculture UG programmes, all modes; about 31% are women

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join through campus placement or company drives as a trainee or territory sales officer. Two-wheeler travel and posting in rural areas are typical conditions.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Product knowledge of seeds and agro-chemicals

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: area sales manager, regional manager, marketing or product roles.
Targets are seasonal and pressure peaks before sowing seasons.
An MBA in agri-business is a common later step for management roles.
